title: Banquet Operations Manager
description:
Namaskar Dear, We thank you for expressing interest in joining our team. We value talented individuals like yourself and look forward to the possibility of growing and succeeding together. 
 Key Responsibilities To drive business growth, run day to day operations smoothly, Should be one point contact with clients requirements. Should be able to understand clients requirements and should provide best solutions/options. To increase occupancy rate for Banquet halls, Rooms and Garden. Complete responsibility of P&L of business. Operations Management: Oversee day-to-day operations. Ensure smooth functioning of all departments. Maintain cleanliness, ambience, safety, and service quality standards. Monitor occupancy, reservations, and guest requirements. Guest Relations: Ensure exceptional guest hospitality and satisfaction. Handle guest feedback, complaints, and special requests professionally. Build long-term relationships with guests and corporate clients. Team Management: Recruit, train, supervise, and motivate staff. Prepare duty rosters and monitor staff performance. Maintain discipline and positive work culture. Sales & Business Development: Promote packages, events, and activities. Coordinate with marketing and sales teams for business growth. Develop partnerships with travel agents, corporates, and event planners. Increase occupancy and revenue generation. Financial Management: Monitor budgets, expenses, and revenue. Ensure cost control without compromising guest experience. Prepare operational and financial reports. Food & Beverage Coordination: Supervise kitchen operations. Ensure food quality, hygiene, and timely service. Coordinate banquet and event arrangements. Maintenance & Safety: Ensure proper maintenance of infrastructure. Monitor safety, security, and emergency procedures. Ensure compliance with local regulations and hospitality standards. Event & Activity Management: Coordinate guest activities, retreats, weddings, corporate events experiences. Ensure successful execution of events and programs. To arrange a property tour to every client and explaining all the amenities and packages available with us and suggesting the best option suitable to the clients requirement. Maintenance of daily registers, Meeting and greeting all clients and Maintaining individual clients record for mutual reference and benefits. Co-ordination with Head Office Should have the ability to handle a team and lead by example Ready to roam anywhere in Odisha region for products and services in case of any business tie ups requirements. To maintaining and cleaning of Rooms, Halls, Garden and other assests. Should achieve the target given by the company. 
 Skillset Required: - Fluency in Odia, Hindi, English - Communication Skills, Good Personality, Serving to Clients Needs, Market Knowledge, Presentation Skills, Energy Level, Clients satisfaction with the best services, Professionalism. - Qualification: Graduation or Post Graduation - B.B.A. / M.B.A/ B.S.W/ M.S.W - Experience: 2 years- 4 years - Job Location: Odisha, Bhawanipatna In case of travelling, travelling allowance and Dearness allowance will be given timely by the company.

Key Skills: Banquet Operations,Event Sales,Catering,Coordination,Event planning,Promotions,Corporate Events,Event management
